correctness.rationale: An exact series–parallel formula yields a concave quadratic on each edge; the maximizing arcs are exactly those of maximum length. The positive larger quadratic root uniquely gives m; Vieta reconstructs the remaining two positive lengths for k=3. Two explicitly different k=4 multisets share sum, reciprocal sum, and maximum; adding equal small arcs yields all k>4. Convexity/majorization and exact factorization prove the sharp equal-length lower bound and unattained upper bound. Rational Kirchhoff checks provide independent finite corroboration.
